name: @commandrelay/tui
description: Cross-platform terminal UI client for CommandRelay

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const candidates=['dist/cli.js','dist/commandrelay-tui/src/cli.js'];let target='';for(const candidate of candidates){if(fs.existsSync(candidate)){target=candidate;break;}}if(!target){throw new Error('cli.js not found in expected output paths');}if(target!=='dist/cli.js'){fs.copyFileSync(target,'dist/cli.js');}fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755);"
